competing_hypotheses.statement: The 133M seven-day decline in tracked exchange-labelled XRP wallets reflects net customer withdrawal/self-custody.
disconfirming: Wallet balances include cold storage and operational reserves; changes cannot distinguish customer flows from wallet migrations or untracked destinations.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Obtain per-wallet transaction histories, exchange address attestations and transfer-level destination classification.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The Binance hack caused a persistent net decline in Binance XRP reserves.
support: Earlier CryptoQuant reserve series reported a separate approximately 220M decline.
disconfirming: XRP Insights' Binance same-wallet set is +17.6M over 7d and +30.3M over 30d as of Oct 31; provider wallet universes and windows differ.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Crosswalk the five incident source wallets against official Binance PoR addresses and the exact CryptoQuant tracked set.

competing_hypotheses.statement: ETF creations explain the decline in exchange-labelled XRP wallets.
support: ETF holdings-derived weekly flow is +3.39M XRP while exchange-labelled wallets are -133M over 7d.
disconfirming: Different universes and cutoffs; ETF holdings changes are not gross spot executions; no transfer-level link.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Compare issuer creation/redemption records, custodian wallet movements and exchange transfer hashes at aligned cutoffs.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The November 1 1B XRP escrow eligibility will create immediate spot sell pressure.
support: Two objects totaling 1B XRP become eligible at 00:00 UTC.
disconfirming: No EscrowFinish verified at cutoff; destination is predetermined; historical 70% re-escrow is only a baseline; no exchange sale evidence.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Trace EscrowFinish, destination, subsequent transfers, EscrowCreate and order-book impact.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Positive aggregate funding and 75.2% long accounts indicate crowded-long liquidation risk.
support: Positive OI-weighted funding, OI growth and long-account skew.
disconfirming: Bybit and OKX funding negative; account share is not notional exposure; liquidations are incomplete lower bounds.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Align notional long/short exposure, basis, depth, venue OI and liquidation history.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Binance has independently demonstrated 100% XRP reserve backing after the incident.
support: Binance states XRP is 100% backed in its Oct 31 PoR snapshot.
disconfirming: Full zk proof estimated Nov 3; exact XRP units, official address list and same-time customer liabilities have not been independently reconciled.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Verify the full proof, XRP reserve addresses and customer net liabilities at the same snapshot time.
